summary: Comprehensive regression of redesigned EventDetail (Overview/Stakeholders/Plan/Budget) after visual rewrite. Backend: re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_event_journeys.py → 18/18 passed (baseline preserved). Frontend: full end-to-end Playwright walkthrough on public URL against a temporary event (TEST_EVT_346, deleted at end). Verified: (1) event-detail-page loads with stat strip + day-by-day schedule, (2) Stakeholders inline edit row with labeled h-10 inputs (measured offsetHeight=40px), external create/edit/delete with S.No, internal stakeholder auto-fills contact_name+email from Employee dropdown (40 employees listed), (3) Plan inline task create with labeled Task/Desc/Owner/Start/End/Depends-On/Status fields, S.No row, status change via view-row dropdown (persists), inline edit, paperclip file upload appears as task-file chip, delete via hover trash, (4) Budget: draft add-budget-line inline row (Category/Description/Vendor/Planned/Actual), footer totals update, inline edit persists (30,000), vendor bill upload chip appears (Receipt icon), Submit-for-Approval transition dialog with comment → state chip becomes 'Pending Approval', add button disappears, budget-lock-note shown; Approve dialog with per-line approved-amount inputs (28,000) → state 'Approved', Approval Trail lists both actions with user name (Surya Yadavalli) + timestamps + comments, (5) Event Report button downloads PDF (filename '... - Event Report.pdf'), (6) Edit Event dialog updates event name in header ('TEST_EVT_346_edited' visible in header per screenshot). No functionality regressed.
critical_code_review_comments: EventDetail.js is 903 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap. Consider splitting each tab (StakeholdersTab / PlanTab / BudgetTab) and the two inline edit-row components into their own files for maintainability. Not blocking.

Delete buttons on hover rows do not have a dedicated data-testid (only the wrapping div is stylable). Tests currently locate them via a Tailwind color class selector. Add data-testid like `stakeholder-delete-{name}` / `task-delete-{name}` / `budget-delete-{category}` to HoverActions for robust future testing.
`downloadFile` / `downloadBudgetFile` / `downloadReport` do not check res.ok before creating a blob — a 4xx would still trigger a download of an error JSON. Minor UX polish.
